paragraphs: Reliability engineer with seven years of production ownership, most of it spent making paging quieter and recoveries faster for teams that ship every day.
American University of Beirut Graduated June 2018
Bachelor of Engineering in computer and communications engineering, with a final year project on distributed tracing for message queues.
Python and Go for tooling, Terraform for infrastructure, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry for instrumentation, and enough SQL to answer the questions the dashboards refuse to.
Ran the weekly laboratory session for the operating systems course and rewrote the grading scripts the department still uses today.
Arabic as a native language, English at full professional level, and French at a working level for client correspondence.
